patch.summary: Cursor cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Cursor pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Hobby. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Cursor cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Cursor against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Hobby until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, reasoning / advanced models, writing and paraphrasing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Switching editors is a real adoption cost vs Copilot-in-VS-Code. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
